reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team. I confirmed I'd noted that the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form is due 26 July, per Finance's updated sheet. I also pointed out that 26 July has already passed (it's 14 October), so it may be worth checking with Finance whether they meant a different year or month.

I didn't take any other action, since Ilse said none was needed. A deadline date counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.
